scope: Focused primary-source review, not a systematic or exhaustive census of every atlas or every market competitor.

sources.title: AMI: Learn About Medical Illustration
sources.application: Medical illustration combines scientific research, visual communication and subject-expert collaboration. Professional competence cannot be inferred from attractive images.

sources.title: AMI Code of Ethics
sources.application: Use honest attribution, permissions and confidential handling of entrusted material. PDF and its single page were inspected.

sources.title: Netter Images
sources.application: A reference for anatomical craft and licensed illustration, not an open asset collection. No Netter artwork is included.

sources.title: BioRender academic licence
sources.application: Do not extract icons or redistribute a competing standalone library. Check the applicable account licence for each finished figure.

sources.title: BioRender figure citation guidance
sources.application: Citation and reuse conditions must be checked for the actual licensed figure; a public image is not an unrestricted asset source.

sources.title: Servier Medical Art
sources.application: Reusable professional medical drawings under CC BY 4.0; retain attribution and identify adaptations. No provider files are bundled.

sources.title: How to cite Servier Medical Art
sources.application: Use the attribution guidance supplied by the rights holder and preserve the Creative Commons link.

sources.title: NIH BioArt Source
sources.application: Professional scientific assets searchable by subject. Read the licence of each entry.

sources.title: NIH BioArt Source FAQ
sources.application: The collection contains public-domain and attribution-licensed material. Do not infer a blanket licence from NIH hosting.

sources.title: NIH BioArt Source terms
sources.application: Users must verify fitness and comply with entry-specific attribution; provider availability is not a medical endorsement of a downstream figure.

sources.title: Bioicons repository
sources.application: Open SVG collection with separate CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, MIT and BSD paths. Asset-level rights differ from website code rights.

sources.title: Bioicons browser
sources.application: Searchable biological icons for vector editors. Do not count a link to the collection as a bundled or tested local library.

sources.title: diagrams.net: Biochemistry clipart
sources.application: An existing Bioicons route for diagrams.net. Reuse it when its connector semantics are sufficient.

sources.title: SciDraw
sources.application: Candidate community resource. The dynamic site did not expose sufficient licence text in this review; verify each item before use.

sources.title: Z-Anatomy anatomical models
sources.application: The repository states CC BY-SA 4.0. Useful as a 3D reference route; no model is bundled, imported or validated here.

sources.title: FIPAT terminology portal
sources.application: Use a named terminology and version; the portal lists Terminologia Anatomica Humana 2024 and other terminologies. A terminology label does not verify geometry.

sources.title: TA2 viewer
sources.application: Versioned TA2 lookup is available. Do not silently call every terminology source the newest edition.

sources.title: Uberon anatomy ontology
sources.application: Use stable, verified terms for cross-species anatomy; record the ontology release and relation type.

sources.title: Cell Ontology
sources.application: Use verified natural cell-type identifiers with a pinned release; do not invent identifiers from labels.

sources.title: NLM MeSH
sources.application: MeSH supports discovery and indexing, not spatial reconstruction or geometric validation.

sources.title: Systems Biology Graphical Notation
sources.application: Process Description, Activity Flow and Entity Relationship have different semantics. This toolkit uses a declared house notation, not an SBGN certification.

sources.title: SBGN specifications
sources.application: Formal SBGN delivery requires the appropriate specification and a separate conformance check, not only familiar-looking arrows.

sources.title: DICOM patient image coordinate definitions
sources.application: Do not confuse patient coordinates, image orientation and display convention. Preserve the coordinate frame and laterality.

sources.title: W3C WAI: Complex images
sources.application: Provide a concise text alternative and the necessary extended explanation for complex scientific figures.

sources.title: WCAG: Use of Color
sources.application: Do not encode distinctions exclusively through colour. Pair semantic colours with text, shape, line type or pattern.

sources.title: Rougier et al. Ten Simple Rules for Better Figures
sources.application: Make composition depend on the intended message, audience and medium. Numerical toolkit defaults are house rules, not claims of a universal journal standard.

sources.title: PLOS ONE figure preparation guidance
sources.application: Check current final figure format and resolution requirements for the target journal. The generic toolkit profile is not a journal acceptance guarantee.

sources.title: Elsevier generative AI policies for journals
sources.application: AI-assisted explanatory diagrams require oversight/disclosure. Primary research images and graphical abstracts have different restrictions; journal rules must be checked.

sources.title: Nature Portfolio AI policy
sources.application: Full policy could not be retrieved in this review. Read the current official policy for the target journal; no pre-approved export profile is supplied.

sources.title: OpenStax A&P 2e, 4.2 Epithelial Tissue
sources.application: Reference for polarity and epithelial organisation. Original geometry is not copied from its figures; verify current item/version rights before reusing textbook content.

sources.title: OpenStax A&P 2e, 20.1 Blood Vessel Structure
sources.application: Reference for schematic vessel-wall organisation. Illustrated layer widths are not measurements.

sources.title: OpenStax A&P 2e, Chapter 25 review / microscopic anatomy
sources.application: Reference for nephron segment continuity and distinction between the nephron and its collecting system. No copied textbook illustration is included.

sources.title: OpenStax Biology 2e, Signalling Molecules and Receptors
sources.application: Reference for explanatory ligand/receptor categories. The specimen is an invented abstract example, not a named experimentally established pathway.

sources.title: OpenStax A&P 2e, 3.2 Cytoplasm and Organelles
sources.application: Recommended verification target for generic organelle symbols; detailed asset-level review has not been performed.

sources.title: OpenStax A&P 2e, 4.3 Connective Tissue
sources.application: Recommended verification target for connective-tissue cell and matrix symbols.

sources.title: OpenStax A&P 2e, Chapter 18 Blood
sources.application: Recommended verification target for blood-cell symbols; they are not cytology evidence or diagnostic classifiers.

sources.title: OpenStax A&P 2e, Chapter 21 Immunity
sources.application: Recommended verification target for generic immune-cell and antibody symbols.

sources.title: RCSB PDB usage policies
sources.application: Distinguish CC0 archive coordinate data from attribution-licensed educational images. Record structure ID, method, source paper and the rendering decisions.

sources.title: CairoSVG documentation
sources.application: CairoSVG handles the optional SVG-to-PNG/PDF export. Unsafe XML processing is never enabled.

sources.title: Medical Illustration Studio original design rules
sources.application: Original procedural schematic geometry and house defaults. This is not independent biological evidence.

sources.title: RCSB PDB-101 Goodsell Gallery
sources.application: Molecular landscapes combine structural, microscopy and biophysical information with explicit omissions. The gallery states CC BY 4.0 with per-illustration acknowledgement. No artwork is bundled.
